Hi Vivek,

Thanks for taking a minute to read this. I'm Elena, Head of Partnerships at Bridgeway Labs — we run an 8-week AI accelerator for early-stage climate startups. Several founders in our next cohort want to evaluate Redwood for inference (low-latency customer-facing agents + embeddings for search).

Two asks from our side:
- Qualification: Are there program criteria to confirm eligibility for promotional credits (pilot-level grants)?
- Onboarding: If eligible, can credits start immediately so our teams can run a 60-90 day extended trial during the cohort?

I've attached a one-pager with the cohort profile and basic signal on expected usage (mostly embeddings + chat burst traffic). We typically ask for a small promotional allocation so founders can build real demos.

If you can point me to the right process, we can share company names and minimal DD. Ideally we'd lock an allocation by next Wednesday (Aug 2) to sync with our welcome call.

Thanks — happy to jump on a 20-min call if that's easier.

Best,
Elena Morales
Head of Partnerships | Bridgeway Labs
elena@bridgeway.ai

Hi Elena — great to meet you (virtually). Thanks for the overview — Bridgeway's cohort mix looks like a good fit. A few quick clarifying Qs so we can scope the right credit package: 

1) Expected active founders and accounts to be onboarded during the cohort? (ballpark is fine)
2) Typical monthly token/embedding volume per demo (or an estimate of concurrent sessions) — prevents under-provisioning
3) Any regulatory constraints (on-prem / VPC required) for any participants?

Our standard pilot path for programs is:
- Conditional promotional credit (applied to the program account) covering up to 3 months, renewable for an additional 1–3 months upon milestone checks.
- Mutually agreed Milestone Plan (demo schedule, simple quality gate: 1 live demo or 2 validated prompts).
- Light DD: company name, domain, and a rapid security checklist (SOC2 / self-attestation items).

If that aligns, Marissa will run the Mutual Action Plan and Ben will scope the final credit amount. For timing: we can provision a temporary sandbox within 48 hours once we have the company list and the HubSpot record or signed acknowledgement.

Happy to take a 20-min call if you want to walk the cohort list together — available Tue 11:00–13:00 PDT.

Cheers,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Partnerships | Redwood Inference
vivek@redwood.ai

Hi Elena — looping in the onboarding ops playbook.

Elena, attaching a short Mutual Action Plan template we use for cohort credit grants. Recommend the following simple flow:
- You share a list of up to 10 founder accounts with domains + a lead contact by Wed Aug 2.
- Redwood provisions a program-level credit pool: $15K/month for up to 3 months, initially placed on a review hold.
- Founders get sandbox keys scoped to the program account; we collect a short sec attestation per company (link in the template).
- At 45 days we do a check-in; credits can be extended if at least 3 founders have completed a live demo or meet usage thresholds.

If Bridgeway needs a longer trial window for academic or procurement reasons, we can consider a 120-day window for cohort-wide access subject to a commercial review. That needs approval from financing (Ben) and legal.

I dropped the MAP template here (redwood_map_template.xlsx). If you want, I can draft prefilled entries for the first 5 companies once you share names.

Thanks — Marissa
Marissa Cole

- Security: none of the teams require on-prem or VPC for the pilot. SOC2 attestation is fine.

Elena — appreciate the fast turnaround and the roster. Internal decision: we can provision the program credit pool as requested. Outline below (formal credit agreement to follow):

- Program credit: $15,000/month applied to Bridgeway program account for three months (Aug 7 – Nov 6).
- Extension option: individual teams may be eligible for up to an additional 30 days (120-day max) on a case-by-case basis; approvals routed to Ben (finance) and Kimberly (legal/compliance).
- Conditions: HubSpot company records + SOC2 attestation (simple yes/no form) for each team before provisioning; MAP sign-off by Bridgeway lead.
- Deliverable: One live demo or two validated prompt sets from at least 3 teams by Day 45 to unlock extension.

I've attached the preliminary credit agreement (credit_agreement_v1.pdf) — it contains the credit schedule and the program-level billing contact block. If procurement wants a PO/Invoice cadence, procurement@bridgeway.ai can reply with details and we'll route to billing.

Next steps:
1) Elena — confirm acceptance of the above and share HubSpot links or a CSV of the 7 teams by Fri Aug 4.
2) Marissa — will provision keys and prefill the MAP once list arrives.
3) Kimberly/Legal — I'll loop you on the final credit agreement for signature (DocuSign link to follow).

Happy to jump on a quick call if that speeds things up.

Thanks,
